scope.purpose: Prevent duplicate materialization, shared-file races, and unsupported PASS/closure claims while multiple FA3 workstreams are open.

hardware_workstream.rule: This execution-control branch must not materialize or edit the hardware reconciliation owned by PR #205. Its merged result is consumed later as an integration input.

observed_open_workstreams.name: HU Content Studio and ONNX/CUDA acceptance
OpenModelDB browser and staged download manager

verified_shared_surfaces.policy: SERIALIZE_REBASE_REGENERATE_OR_RECONCILE; never hand-merge stale generated projection content
SERIALIZE; after each merge rebase remaining PRs, reconcile dispatcher entries, rerun permanent/static enforcement
SERIALIZE_GUI_WIRING; preserve all registered surfaces and rerun Qt/GUI gate after reconciliation

execution_rules: No workstream may infer architectural authority from this snapshot.
Do not duplicate a workstream already owned by an open PR or another conversation.
A shared generated release projection is reconciled from the newest accepted base; stale projection content is not manually selected as truth.
A shared dispatcher or GUI registration file is merged serially and then revalidated as a combined surface.
GitHub-hosted/static PASS is not current-host PASS.
Current-host execution is performed only through the workstream's trusted current-host path after the relevant merged/static state is established.
No PENDING_CURRENT_HOST or PENDING_EXECUTABLE_EVIDENCE state is promoted by documentation or this coordination layer.
If this snapshot conflicts with live GitHub or canonical state, the live/canonical state wins and this snapshot must be refreshed.
default_merge_and_validation_sequence: Verify dependency/replacement edges and select the non-superseded PR path.
Merge or reconcile one shared-hotspot workstream at a time.
Rebase remaining affected PRs onto the newest main.
Regenerate/reconcile release projection through the repository's existing mechanism.
Rerun workstream static tests plus permanent canonical/promotion gates required by the repository.
Run trusted current-host collection only for workstreams whose static and merged prerequisites are satisfied.
Write runtime evidence only from actual receipts; retain PENDING otherwise.
Allow workstream-specific closure/promotion only through its canonical acceptance/evidence authority.
